set.body:
Tabular, declared-lossy export of a StoryModel for psychology and neuroimaging users, reusing the conventions of the mapping exchange tables (bd-01M2WVHF4B5DAXJYY4W91VK4WV).
Acceptance:
1. From a validated StoryModel (text; film when compileFilm exists), write versioned tables: nodes (id, kind, context, status), relations, evidence support (text spans or exact playback intervals/points, never mixed or narrowed), hierarchy/segments, plus a manifest that names every dropped structure (loss record) and binds the source StoryModel checksum.
2. An independent Python or R reader recovers node and evidence counts and one hand-checked row. Absent or unmeasured values stay distinguishable from zero.
3. A model that failed validation is refused. No field is silently defaulted.
Gate: reference-scope, SD2 checkAll with bound totals, named mutations for each loss record, SD6 review.
